tasks.question: Is a Kannada keyboard built in, and is it the KGP layout that Karnataka's typists learn?

english.text: 6 of 6 built in, all with QWERTY

tasks.title: Find a Kannada font that renders every letter
tasks.question: Of the free Kannada fonts people download, how many draw every modern letter and conjunct correctly?
tasks.line: 27 of 37 free Kannada fonts render every modern letter, including 11 of 11 on Google Fonts.
tasks.method: fontqa shapes 1,851 modern syllables, vowels and conjuncts with HarfBuzz. A font fails if any upright style has a missing glyph, a dotted circle, a broken conjunct or arkavattu, or draws 2 different strings the same.
notes: Fail: Cheluvi, Gubbi, Kanishka, Kannada Pixel, Karnata Bandipur, Karnata F Kittel, Karnata German Mission Press, Nishchaya, Nudi Unicode fonts (KaGaPa), Sriraju.
Choice is a separate gap: Google Fonts has 11 Kannada families and 1,840 Latin ones.
Rare and old letters (ಱ, ೞ, ೝ, ೳ, U+0CDC, vocalic L) are left out; of the fonts tested, only Nanni has them all.
An English writer gets every Latin font; Google Fonts' Latin subset covers the English alphabet by definition.

tasks.title: Search a government PDF
tasks.question: When a Karnataka government PDF has a text layer, does searching or copying it give the right words?
tasks.line: 8 of 123 Kannada PDFs give correct text when searched, against 103 of 108 English PDFs from the same sites.
tasks.method: 552 PDFs sampled from 50 Karnataka government sites in November 2026. A Kannada PDF counts if its text is Unicode and under 15% of its words are broken; an English PDF if under 15% of its words are broken and 60% or more are dictionary words.

sources.label: Karnataka government PDF audit, PDF rows
English text layers of the same sample

notes: 53 of the 123 Kannada PDFs store some or all of their text as legacy font codes; most of the rest lose their conjuncts when the text is extracted.
315 of the 552 PDFs are scans with no text layer; they are left out of both sides.
6 more have a text layer that is not readable words in any language (some are Kannada in fonts with no Unicode map); they are left out too.
tasks.with_open_kannada: kannadi converts the legacy-coded text once it is copied out; the broken conjuncts need fixing where the PDFs are made.

tasks.title: Ask an AI model in Kannada
tasks.question: How many more tokens, and so how much more money and context, does the same message cost in Kannada?
tasks.line: The same message costs 1.83 times as many tokens in Kannada with o200k, the tokenizer of GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 and the o-series.
tasks.method: Tokens for the 960 parallel WMT24++ segments, Kannada over English, counted with the public tokenizer (kannada-llm-bench). Price, speed and context use scale with tokens.
notes: Across 12 distinct public tokenizers (tokenizers with identical counts count once) the ratio runs from 1.14 to 8.27.
tiktoken 0.14 maps GPT-5 to o200k as well.
Claude and Gemini are not measured: their tokenizers are not public and counting needs an API key.
Answer quality in Kannada is not scored here; kannada-llm-bench has the test suite.
